categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily designs, manufactures, and installs fully automatic metal tube processing equipment including bending machines, cutting machines, and tube end forming machines, as well as various machine tools. It also engages in parts sales and provides integrated automation solutions for industries such as automotive, furniture, electronics, shipbuilding, and aerospace. The business segments include fully automatic plant equipment and machine tools.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced CNC (computer numerical control) technology, servo motor-driven electric bending machines, and AI-enabled intelligent bending machines with machine learning capabilities. It develops integrated automation workstations combining bending, cutting, forming, and inspection processes, supported by proprietary control software and big data analytics platforms. Laser cutting technology with robotic arms and fiber laser sources is also a key production method, enabling high-precision, energy-efficient, and flexible metal processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers and suppliers, furniture makers, electronics factories, heavy industries such as shipbuilding and boiler manufacturing, and other sectors requiring metal tube processing. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales to North America, Asia, and Europe. Its products are critical for automotive parts production, including exhaust pipes, bumpers, and piping systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Tainan and sales offices worldwide. It has established subsidiaries and sales/service networks in countries including the United States, Poland, Turkey, Russia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, India, Indonesia, and China. Major export markets include North America, Asia (notably Southeast Asia), and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing specialized machinery and automation equipment used by downstream manufacturers in automotive and other metal-processing industries. It relies on upstream suppliers for key components such as reducers, controllers, servo motors, and drives, integrating these into its automated production systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on developing high value-added, intelligent, and automated production equipment aligned with Industry 4.0 trends. R&D initiatives emphasize AI-enabled bending machines, integrated automation workstations, robotic laser cutting systems, and proprietary software platforms for production data management and optimization. The company aims to shorten product development cycles, enhance modular design, and expand applications beyond automotive to diversified industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of fully automatic metal tube processing equipment, machine tools, and related parts. The company also earns income from installation services and after-sales technical support. It maintains a global sales and service network to support recurring business and customer retention.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Competitors include domestic firms such as Hehe Machinery and Qiaosheng Machinery, and international manufacturers from the UK, Italy, Japan, Sweden, and the US like Addison, BLM Group, Chiyoda, Comco, Herber, and Eaton Leonard. In machine tools, competitors include large multinational companies from Germany, Japan, Italy, Korea, and China. The company positions itself through flexible, customized solutions, strong R&D capabilities, and extensive global after-sales service networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net revenues of approximately NT$776.8 million, a 4.67% increase from the previous year, with a net loss reduced by 46.93% to NT$45.55 million. The company has a capital stock of 87.5 million shares and total assets around NT$2.27 billion. Despite recent losses, the company is investing in R&D and expanding global markets, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced AI and Industry 4.0-enabled automation solutions that reduce labor costs and improve production efficiency and quality. Its proprietary software platforms enable real-time machine monitoring, predictive maintenance, and optimized production scheduling. The modular and customizable design of its equipment caters to diverse customer needs, supported by a comprehensive global service network ensuring minimal downtime and high customer satisfaction.
